solver_notes: Native Linux/AArch64 tagged-pointer ABA regression model executed on the physical Cortex-A72; this is not a claimed upstream CPython patch (the metadata pairs CPython with a synthetic C target). The legacy path compares only the recycled head pointer and reproduces ABA with a gated pop A/pop B/push A interleaving. The fixed path uses a 16-byte {pointer,uint64_epoch} head and real ARMv8 LDAXP/STLXP 128-bit CAS, incrementing the full 64-bit epoch on every successful head mutation. The corrected CCMP fallback NZCV=#0 rejects pointer mismatches; #4 was found by concurrent stress to be wrong and was not shipped. Earlier harness attempts timed out and then exposed duplicate pops; those failures are retained in debug logs. Final execution includes the deterministic case, primary 40,000-node 4-producer/4-consumer stress, five repeated fixed/stress runs, and both requested pytest entry points. Nodes are preallocated and not freed during stress, so the test isolates ABA/tag correctness rather than claiming a general safe-memory reclamation scheme. file_sha256_of_this_json is computed with that field set to the empty string; solution_payload_sha256.txt binds final transmitted bytes.
